$comment: Each record is a Schema.org Organization (https://schema.org/Organization), usually a Corporation. Plan and decisions: _prompts/2026-10-31-corporations-dataset-plan.md. Documented at https://fossfoundation.info/corporations
title: Corporations Schema
description: Key sponsors that fund several FOSS foundations. Records hold our identifier, the domains that join them to sponsor data, and lookup identifiers for authoritative sources; facts that GLEIF, SEC EDGAR or Wikidata maintain are left to them.

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: Our stable id for this organization, also the file name. Unique across _foundations, _entities and _corporations, and never renamed or reused.

commonName.title: Common Name
commonName.description: The brand name that appears in sponsor lists, e.g. Google. A record is one sponsoring brand, not its listed parent company, unless two or more sponsoring brands roll up to that parent.

legalName.title: Legal Name
legalName.description: Exact legal name of the operating entity behind the brand, taken from GLEIF or a company registry. Leave out until verified.

entityType.title: Entity Type
entityType.description: Kind of legal entity: Corporation for companies; NGO for non-profits such as corporate foundations; GovernmentOrganization for government funds; EducationalOrganization for universities and their labs.

domains.title: Sponsor Domains
domains.description: Join key to all sponsor data: the canonical registrable domains (after _data/host_aliases.json) that sponsor lists and history use for this organization, primary first. Each domain belongs to at most one record.
domains.$comment: No Schema.org equivalent; related to https://schema.org/url

wikidataId.title: Wikidata ID
wikidataId.description: Wikidata item, the hub that links most other identifiers. Same field as in _foundations.

leiCode.title: Legal Entity Identifier
leiCode.description: GLEIF LEI (ISO 17442) of the legalName entity; follow it for parent and child relationships.

cik.title: SEC Central Index Key
cik.description: SEC EDGAR CIK of the registrant whose filings cover this brand: the brand's own company, or the publicly listed parent that owns it (for example Alphabet Inc. for Google). Name the registrant in the source's detail. Leave out for brands whose parent has its own record here.
cik.$comment: Exported as Schema.org identifier PropertyValue with propertyID sec-cik: https://schema.org/PropertyValue

taxID.title: Tax ID
taxID.description: US EIN or other tax identifier, only for non-profit records such as corporate foundations. Same field as in _foundations.

sameAs.title: Same As
sameAs.description: Registry and directory pages we link to but don't copy from, such as OpenCorporates, UK Companies House, PermID, or ROR.

parentOrganization.title: Parent Organization
parentOrganization.description: Owner of this brand when that owner also has a record here, with dates, so sponsor history can be rolled up by owner.

identifier.description: Identifier of the parent's record in _corporations.

endDate.description: Date ownership ended, if it has.

source.description: Where the ownership and dates can be checked, preferably the parent's own announcement or an SEC filing.

opensourceurl.title: Open Source URL
opensourceurl.description: The organization's main public open source page or OSPO site, such as the one listed for it in the TODO Group OSPO Landscape.

ospourl.title: OSPO URL
ospourl.description: Its Open Source Program Office page, when that is a separate page from opensourceurl.
ospourl.$comment: Schema.org url: https://schema.org/url; OSPO as defined by the TODO Group: https://todogroup.org/

policyurl.title: Open Source Policy URL
policyurl.description: Its published open source contribution or usage policy.

leadershipurl.title: Leadership URL
leadershipurl.description: The organization's own page listing its executives or board. We link to it instead of storing names.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Where each stored value can be checked again.

detail.description: What the source shows and which fields it supports, in one sentence.

lastReviewed.title: Last Reviewed
lastReviewed.description: Date the whole record was last reviewed.

reviewedBy.title: Reviewed By
reviewedBy.description: GitHub login of the person who last reviewed the whole record.
